subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Performance Regression Detection
description: A short lesson to help you apply Performance Regression Detection.

hook.text: A feature ships on Monday. By Friday, page load is 40% slower. Nobody connects the dots until users complain.

buildup.text: Performance regressions sneak in with code changes, dependency updates, and configuration tweaks.

discovery.text: Automated performance tests in CI compare every build against the baseline to catch slowdowns early.

twist.text: Small regressions—50ms here, 100ms there—compound silently until the system feels sluggish.

climax.text: A CI gate flags a 15% regression on Wednesday. The team fixes it before Friday users ever notice.

punchline.text: Catch regressions in CI. Not in customer complaints.

quiz.question: How are performance regressions best caught?
options: Automated CI tests comparing against baselines
